newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPGs steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPGs steady in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were steady in quiet late trade on Wednesday amid weak NYMEX crude oil futures, players said.
"A lot of people have stepped back to gauge where the market is headed," said one Houston trader.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane remained between 49.00 cents and 49.50 cents a gallon, about a quarter cent lower than yesterday.
In Conway, Kansas, spot material also held steady at midday levels, at 49.00/49.25 cents, players said.
The market opened higher on Wednesday but began to fall late morning when NYMEX November crude oil futures started to drop. Crude oil ended down 25 cents at $25.17 a barrel.

Conway natural gasoline also remained at a high of 59.25 cents due buying refiners that want to blend the material with gasoline. Natural gasoline is a preferred blending stock in the winter because of its high vapor pressure.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
